verdict.rationale: v0 explicitly markets an API for 'programmatic access to all of v0's capabilities' including chat, code generation, project management, and deployment (v0-docs-4, v0-gh-1/2), suggesting broad parity. However, several UI-only workflows—GitHub branch/PR management, CI fix/conflict resolution, visual style editing, command palette—have no documented API equivalents in the evidence pack, so full parity is unverified.
